observations: Photo 0: front panel of a beige office photocopier under plastic wrap, printed label 'SHARP AR-M207' clearly readable.
Photo 1: side and front of a similar copier, 'SHARP' and a model label partly legible, 'digital' logo, Energy Star sticker, two paper cassettes marked A4 and A3.
Photo 2: top and front of a copier with 'SHARP AR-M207' label, wooden board on top, wrapped in film.
All photos carry a dealer watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT'; the machines appear to sit on a pallet in a warehouse.
No photo shows the machine powered on, a display, a copy output, a page counter or a serial plate.
Plastic wrap hides surface condition; no view of the glass, document cover underside, drum or toner.

claims.claim: London use (imported used from the UK)
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown by photos; no import documents or UK plug shown.

claims.claim: AR-M207 with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Model AR-M207 is supported by the labels in photos 0 and 2, but no photo shows the machine powered on or copying, so function is unproven.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, copy, print or scan.
risks.proof: A clip of the machine powering on, making a copy from the glass and feeding a sheet out of the A4 cassette.

risks.risk: High page count or worn drum and fuser, which sets the remaining life.
risks.proof: A photo of the counter or maintenance report printout showing total page count.
risks.if_unproven: as high count, drum and fuser needing replacement

risks.risk: Toner cartridge and developer missing or empty.
risks.proof: A photo with the front cover open showing the toner cartridge and drum unit installed.

risks.risk: Cracked or scratched glass and damaged panels hidden under plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photo of the unwrapped machine with the document cover lifted showing the scanner glass and control panel.

risks.risk: Photos may show several different units from a dealer stock, not the one being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the specific unit with a handwritten note of today's date and the serial plate on the back.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powered on making a copy from the glass.
Photo of the page counter or printed configuration report.
Photo with front cover open showing toner cartridge and drum.
Photo of the serial plate at the rear with a handwritten note of today's date.
Unwrapped photo showing scanner glass and control panel.
response.reason: Brand and model Sharp AR-M207 are readable on the front label in photos 0 and 2, so the copier can be priced at its worst case as not working until a powered copy test and page count are shown.
